mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 950K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances when HOUST > 950K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 6.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the strong labor market boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter signals reduced supply chain pressures, leading to increased corporate profitability and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) is a persistent driver of S&P 500 returns, as it reflects the overall health of the economy, leading to positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, the tightening monetary cycle increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 150K and unemployment (UNRATE) is below 7%, the combined labor market strength boosts economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a post-shock recovery regime, a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a quarter signals increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS growth > 5% in post-shock recovery, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
